sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Corporate Scope 1-3 Carbon Footprint Auditing and Offset Brokerage

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic), with constitutional supremacy and sector-specific administrative regulation
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement, in force 15 May 2012, including investment chapter
Colombia–Canada Free Trade Agreement, in force 15 August 2011, including investment chapter
Colombia–Chile Free Trade Agreement, in force 8 May 2009, including investment chapter
Colombia–Spain Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation, signed 2005

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 2155 de 2021 (arts. 57-59), Decreto 830 de 2021 and DIAN Resolution 000164 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales); Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF); Ley 1121 de 2006; Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia Circular Básica Jurídica 008 de 2020 and Superintendencia de Sociedades External Circular 2024-03 (SAGRILAFT) govern AML/CFT and UBO identification.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access – the Colombian RUES/DIAN UBO register is not publicly searchable; third parties may only request UBO information from the company or through judicial/regulatory access.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or excerpt from the official commercial registry of each non-resident corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry or chamber of commerce of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization if origin is not a Hague Convention member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolutions and corporate authorizations of each foreign shareholder approving the incorporation of CO_SAS and the designated representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or board of directors of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization in the jurisdiction of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney granted for the incorporation, registration and ongoing representation of CO_SAS
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the place of signature

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport or identity cards and sworn UBO declarations for all direct and indirect natural-person beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority of the UBO's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; Spanish translation where non-Spanish

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All proposed shareholders, directors, signatories and UBOs must be screened before incorporation against the Colombian Listas Nacionales e Internacionales (SAGRILAFT 'Alerta Temprana'), OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List and UK Sanctions List. Politically Exposed Persons trigger enhanced due diligence, senior management approval and continuous transaction monitoring. UBO confirmation requires sworn declarations, registry searches where available, and documentation sufficient to substantiate each 5% ownership or control chain.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social – RUES (https://www.rues.org.co) and the functional online portal of the applicable Cámara de Comercio, e.g. Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be expressed in Spanish or in Latin-script transliteration where an original foreign word is used. The name must end with 'S.A.S.' For foreign-language parent concepts a sworn transliteration may be required; homonymous, misleading, or non-Latin-script names are systematically refused.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names implying a state organ or public authority
Names requiring prior authorization under Colombian financial, insurance, cooperative, transportation and telecommunications legislation
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Chamber of Commerce rejects the proposed name, counsel must file a 'recurso de reposición' before the same Chamber within 10 business days of notification, and a 'recurso de apelación' before the Superintendencia de Sociedades where the Chamber is subject to its supervisory review (Ley 1437 de 2011, arts. 74-78). The administrative appeal must explain registrability, attach a fresh homonimia certificate, and may propose an alternative reserved name. The initial 30-day homonymy certificate cannot be extended; a new search is required after expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permitted. A virtual office or business centre may be designated as the registered office only where a physical Colombian address is maintained, service-of-process and legal-notice acceptance is contractually secured, and the Cámara de Comercio registration carries a georeferenced street address. A post-office box or purely electronic address is not permissible.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for this ISIC 7020 advisory and audit-consulting activity. Approx. 10-15% risk of unannounced verification by the Superintendency of Companies, the DIAN, or the Chamber of Commerce within the first 36 months, mainly triggered by UBO anomalies, invoicing irregularities, or late merchant-registry filings.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and certificate of homonymia (certificado de no homonimia)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed annually by the Chamber

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUES merchant-registry application and pre-registration filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff based on reported assets; estimate for minimum-asset S.A.S.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial protocolization of private incorporation documents and legalization of signatures
Drafting of S.A.S. articles of incorporation and basic corporate governance pack
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a simple single-shareholder S.A.S.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) preparation and submission support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External tax advisor / DIAN (no government fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille of foreign shareholder certificate of existence and good standing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority under the Hague Convention in the document's country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn Spanish translation of foreign shareholder documents
Registered office service with physical reception, mail and process-agent acceptance, first year

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), arts. 1, 4, 5, 15-18 and 22; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), arts. 98-127; Decreto 1074 de 2015, arts. 2.2.2.38.1 et seq. (merchant registration)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the company's domicile (for professional services, typically Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) inscribed in the Registro Mercantil; public deed (escritura pública) required only when real property or significant in-kind contributions are made
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; Ley 1258 permits subscribed capital payable in installments up to 2 years (art. 4). No escrow or bank-account capital lock is required by law, although the registered subscribed capital must be reflected in the by-laws.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION No. 1 OF THE INCORPORATING SHAREHOLDER — [Company Name] S.A.S. The undersigned shareholder, per Ley 1258 de 2008, resolves: (1) to subscribe the authorized capital of COP [amount] divided into [number] ordinary shares, acknowledging the paid instalment and the obligation to discharge any unpaid balance within two years; (2) to approve the private incorporation document as the sole by-laws and to establish the registered office at [street address], Bogotá D.C., Colombia; (3) to appoint [Name] as Legal Representative and [Name] as Alternate Legal Representative with the powers granted under Clause [X]; and (4) to authorize the Legal Representative to carry out the RUES registration, DIAN tax enrollment (RUT), bank account opening, and all ancillary administrative filings required for commencement of operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company name availability search and certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (RUES online portal / in-person service window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability request (consulta de homonimia) for the proposed corporate name, including the acronym 'S.A.S.'. The authority issues a Certificado de Homonimia confirming that no other company in the same juridical jurisdiction has registered an identical name. The certificate is valid for 60 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Name availability request form (Formulario RUES)
Identification document of requesting party
Proof of payment of search fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a homonymous name is found, file a new request with 3 alternative names; no administrative appeal is necessary as re-submission is immediate and free of further notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the private incorporation document and by-laws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (authentication only if required) and founding shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute the Documento Privado de Constitución containing the full by-laws (estatutos) per Ley 1258: corporate name, purpose clause (ISIC 7020 carbon auditing and offset brokerage), subscribed and paid capital, share classes, governance rules, audit provisions, and term. If the capital is paid in cash, no public deed is mandatory; notarization may still be obtained for the founder's signatures where banks or counterparties require certified execution.
required_dossiers: Draft private incorporation document
Shareholder identification documents and RUT
Power of attorney if signed by proxy
Background of the purpose clause aligned to ISIC 7020
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry objects to by-law clauses (e.g., defective purpose clause or capital payment term exceeding 2 years), amend the instrument by a supplemental private document ratified by the shareholder and re-file; no court proceeding is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registration of the company in the RUES (Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed incorporation document together with the RUES registration forms (Formulario de Registro y Formulario Adicional de Registro). Pay the registration fee (derechos de inscripción) and stamp duties. The registry assigns the company's NIT (tax ID) provisional number, enrolls the legal representative, and issues the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Cámara). This step legally perfects the entity's existence.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución (original and copy)
Certificado de Homonimia
Complete RUES forms (single and complementary registration)
Payment receipt of registration fees
Personal identification of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried (requerimiento), the registry grants a 5-business-day cure period: correct the identified documentary or legal defects, file a response within the term, and the registration proceeds retroactively upon approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: DIAN tax registration and RUT enrollment with electronic invoicing activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — online system (SIE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) online using the company's provisional NIT obtained from the Chamber of Commerce. Select the income tax regime (ordinary), VAT responsible status (IVA) based on projected thresholds, ICA as complementary activity, and activate e-invoicing (facturación electrónica) with the authorized resolution. Obtain the digital signature certificate (Certificado de Firma Electrónica) for the legal representative.
required_dossiers: Provisional NIT from RUES certificate
Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
Legal representative identity and digital signature request
Corporate address details
Bank account details for tax refund routing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN blocks registration due to tax-precursor mismatches or pending fiscal obligations of the legal representative, file a written clarification through the DIAN taxpayer service portal; the administration responds within 5 business days and lifts the suspension.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal industry and commerce (ICA) enrollment and establishment registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda de Bogotá (and municipal treasury of the domicile)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enroll the company in the ICA (Impuesto de Industria y Comercio) registry for professional services (code for consultancy services) through the municipal online system. Obtain the boleta de inscripción for the commercial establishment and register the physical office address; this is required for local operation of consultancy activities and generates the ICA annual declaration obligations.
required_dossiers: RUES registration certificate
Commercial lease agreement or property title of registered office
ICA enrollment form
Identification of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality returns the enrollment for missing documentation or incorrect activity tariff code, correct the form within 10 business days and declare the activity under the correct ICA category (communication of the revised tariff) to avoid late-filing fines.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of corporate bank account and post-formation ancillary registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia Financiera-regulated commercial banks in Colombia (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda); Cámara de Comercio for books stamping
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account for wire-transfer receipts (target rails: Swift Wire and domestic transfers) by submitting the legal existence certificate and board authorization. Concurrently, legalize the corporate books (libro de actas, libro de accionistas) at the Chamber of Commerce and register the company with the Central Bank external operations system (DE-1 summary file) if international transactions are anticipated. Enroll the company's payroll and occupational risk insurance (ARL) prior to hiring personnel.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (original less than 90 days old)
Company by-laws (certified copy)
Incorporating shareholder and legal representative identity documents
Board resolution authorizing bank account (extract from corporate books)
Proof of registered office (utility bill or lease contract)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank applies enhanced due diligence on shareholder routine, provide a signed source-of-funds declaration and tax status certificate (Certificado de pago de impuestos); if the Chamber of Commerce defects the book stamping, correct pagination/notarization and re-present within 5 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing authority applies — ISIC 7020 (management consultancy and carbon audit) is an unregulated professional activity; general oversight rests with the Superintendencia de Sociedades for corporate law and DIAN/Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda for taxes.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sectoral operating permit required; the only registrations are the establishment registration (Registro Anexo de la Matrícula Mercantil) and ICA enrollment.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) for projects of national relevance; local environmental authorities (Corporaciones Autónomas Regionales) for urban premises
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-based consultancy has an immaterial environmental footprint; no EIA, environmental license, or emissions permit is triggered under Decree 1076 of 2015, Title III
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emissions generated; applicable compliance limited to (i) municipal solid-waste collection against Resolución 2184 de 2019 segregation rules, (ii) hazardous e-waste generator registration under Resolución 1309 de 2018 if end-of-life IT equipment is handed to licensed recyclers, and (iii) electricity consumption below the 10 MW connected-load threshold.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos (Bogotá) Fire Safety Certificate (Certificado de Bomberos) for the leased/owned office issued after on-site inspection; municipal occupancy permit (uso de suelo y propiedad horizontal clearance) from the Departamento Administrativo de Planeación; workplace safety program per Resolución 0312 de 2019 with affiliation of staff to an ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales); optional structural load report for open-plan floors in multi-tenant buildings.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), through its official portal www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishes a Colombian branch or maintains a local legal representative and applies to DIAN for a Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT). The entity must complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) electronically or in-person, provide the incorporation or foreign registration certificate (apostilled and translated), identify the representative, state the intended economic activities, and obtain the NIT before issuing invoices or operating. The RUT is the unified taxpayer identification and registration record.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not provide a check-the-box pass-through election for Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas (S.A.S.). The S.A.S. is solely subject to entity-level corporate income tax. No hybrid mismatch elections are available under domestic law; taxpayers may apply the group consolidation regime (Régimen de Consolidación) for entities under common control, and may elect the SIMPLE taxation regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación) if small and meeting statutory thresholds, but this does not alter the default entity-level classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis VAT registration threshold; any entity carrying out taxable sales of goods or services in Colombian territory must register for VAT through the RUT with DIAN. For the optional Régimen Simple de Tributación, the gross revenue threshold is set in UVT (about COP 100,000 UVT per calendar year, adjusted annually), but VAT registration remains mandatory for all taxable operations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing (factura electrónica de venta) is mandatory for all VAT-registered taxpayers. Invoices must be issued through DIAN-authorized software or DIAN's free system, transmitted in real time to DIAN's services, and validated before issue. The invoice must incorporate the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or CUDS (Código Único de Documento Soporte) as a digital stamp. APIs and web services of DIAN are used for authentication, transmission, validation, and registration of invoices and supporting documents; deviations trigger automatic rejection or penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Colombia qualify for the 0% VAT rate under the export regime. Services qualify if the recipient has no domicile or permanent establishment in Colombia, the service is used or exploited exclusively outside Colombian territory, and the consideration is paid by a non-resident through the authorized foreign exchange market (when remittance is required). The supply must be directly related to the export or performed abroad; supporting documentation must evidence the fulfillment of these conditions.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign exchange settlement (Certificado de Reintegro) evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Commercial Invoice issued to the foreign purchaser
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may audit zero-rated exports retroactively. If the taxpayer fails to evidence the physical export, effective provision of offshore services, or timely foreign exchange repatriation, DIAN will assess the VAT at 19% plus applicable overpayment indexation, a penalty of up to 100% of the tax evaded or omitted, and interest for late payment. False or fictitious export declarations can give rise to criminal tax evasion charges, customs penalties, and disqualification from refund mechanisms. The applicable statute of limitations for DIAN assessments is generally six years, extendable in cases of non-declaration or fraudulent conduct.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (BANREP) ... operative powers under Law 9 of 1991, the Foreign Exchange Statute (Estatuto Cambiario, Decree 1068 of 2015), Resolución Externa 8 of 2000, Resolución Externa 1 of 2018 ... jointly administered by DIAN (exchange declarations) and supervised on the financial side by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: COP is fully convertible for current-account transactions including service export earnings, dividends and interest remittances, subject to mandatory channeling through the official foreign exchange market ('canalización') by an authorized intermediary... Capital-account flows (FDI, foreign loans) are freely transferable but require registration / exchange declaration... For a carbon-audit SAS with 100% non-resident ownership, no prior central bank approval is needed; but the foreign investment must be filed through the 'Declaración de Cambio' with code 1001 within the statutory window (file within 6 months from channeling) to legalize future dividend/equity repatriation... Withholding applicable: 5% dividend WHT for non-resident shareholders (Tax Code), plus no exchange-surplus authorization required...
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Resolución Externa 1 of 2018, the mandatory surrender / conversion ratio for service export proceeds was abolished... The obligation is now timely 'canalización' (channeling) of export receivables through an authorized FX intermediary within 6 months from the invoice/service-completion date (per DIAN Circular DCIN-83, Section 03.04). 100% of the remittance must be accompanied by the electronic exchange declaration... proceeds may be collected in foreign currency and credited to a foreign-currency account at a local intermediary (cuenta de compensación) without forced sale to the market... failure = administrative fines & tax disallowance...

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of Commercial Registry Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) of the registered domicile; oversight by Superintendencia de Sociedades for SAS legal capacity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Every fiscal year from 1 January to 31 March.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal charges and interest; continued non-renewal can suspend the company's commercial registry status, preclude favorable commercial certificates, and trigger administrative strike-off/cancellation proceedings by the Chamber of Commerce.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Financial Statements (Depósito de Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the SAS's registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' ordinary meeting to adopt financial statements by 31 March; deposit of the signed meeting minutes and financial statements within 15 calendar days after approval.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Superintendencia de Sociedades imposes administrative fines for failure to deposit; inability to obtain 'good standing' certificate (certificado de existencia y representación) which blocks participation in public tenders and certain banking transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (Asamblea General de Accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate governance record; minutes are kept in the corporate minute book and a copy is required for the Chamber deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be convened and held no later than 31 March following the prior fiscal year-end, unless bylaws establish an earlier date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance may invalidate the accounts' approval; the SAS may face regulatory fines and inability to file the accounts with the Chamber of Commerce.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Final Beneficiary Information Filing (RUBF – Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually per the DIAN calendar based on the NIT's last digit, ordinarily during the May–June tax window; reporting is mandatory even when no beneficial ownership changes have occurred.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Untimely or inaccurate filing triggers fines under Article 651 of the Tax Code and specific RUBF penalties, up to USD 25,000 equivalent; operations with financial entities may be restricted.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Share Transfer Ledger Updating and/or Capital Book Adjustment (Registro de Transferencia de Acciones)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (optional formal registration of the share transfer) and internal company ledger maintained at the legal address
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each transfer of shares, and confirmed annually with the Mercantile Registry renewal by 31 March.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Undisclosed share transfers are ineffective against third parties; incorrect or incomplete statutory books may lead to penalties under the Código de Comercio and expose the transferee to economic loss.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: SAS must appoint a Revisor Fiscal (independent statutory auditor) if at the close of the prior year: (i) gross assets exceed 5,000 monthly minimum legal wages (SMMLV) (approx COP 7.3 billion / USD 1.8 million); (ii) gross revenue exceeds 3,000 SMMLV (approx COP 4.4 billion / USD 1.1 million); (iii) legal provisions applicable to the industry require it; or (iv) the SAS carries out public-interest activities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: COLGAAP - Colombia's IFRS-based accounting framework: NIIF for PYMES (IFRS for SMEs) as adopted under Decree 2420/2015 for Grupo 2 entities; full NIIF for Grupo 1 public-interest entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual RUBF confirmation is compulsory in Colombia: the legal representative must identify each individual who directly or indirectly owns or exerts control, including participation equal to or above 5% of share capital or voting rights. Share transfers must be recorded in the Shareholders Ledger in real time and, even absent transfers, the annual RUBF submission must confirm the existing ownership structure.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members or Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro de Actas de la Asamblea / Junta Directiva)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas) for Shareholders' and Director Meetings

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic tax holiday is available to a standard SAS. The headline 35% corporate income tax rate applies under Article 240 E.T. A qualifying SAS with gross income below approximately 100,000 UVT may elect the SIMPLE taxation regime, paying progressive rates of roughly 1.8% to 14% depending on activity. Tax deductions are available for ordinary business expenses and, subject to DANE registration, certain R&D/innovation investments may generate an additional 50% deduction or a discounted tax credit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios) filed electronically through the DIAN MUISCA system at www.dian.gov.co
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return must be filed no later than the date published annually by DIAN for the relevant fiscal year. For a calendar-year taxpayer, the deadline generally falls between early April and late May of the following year, determined by the last digit of the taxpayer's NIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income from ESG carbon footprint audits, carbon offset brokerage, and related advisory services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report Colombian-source service income only; foreign-source income must be listed separately and is subject to Colombian tax only when remitted or when a permanent establishment exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income items exempt under the Tax Statute, such as certain dividends or environmental incentive receipts, if supported by law.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot claim Colombian exemptions on service income unless a specific DTA or law grants exempt status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct staff, software, SaaS, subcontracting, certification, travel, and professional fees attributable to the carbon audit and offset brokerage business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions are recognized only when supported by invoices complying with Article 618 E.T. and when expenses have a clear causal relationship with the Colombian-source revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Result after applying deductions, prior-year tax losses, and any presumptive income adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: NOL carryforward is available for 12 fiscal years; the annual offset of losses is limited to 25% of the current taxable income before loss application.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income multiplied by the 35% corporate rate; credits and prepayments are then applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned SAS with a permanent establishment in Colombia must pay at least 35% on its net Colombian taxable income; no notional deduction applies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of the tax payable for each month or partial month of delay, capped at 100%, with a minimum penalty of 50 UVT. Failure to file altogether may trigger assessment of the tax with penalties up to 200% of the omitted amount, plus monetary correction and daily interest.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding on dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders from profits already subject to corporate income tax; 35% withholding on distributions from non-taxed profits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must provide the Colombian paying entity with a valid Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the competent authority of the residence state, plus a sworn declaration of beneficial ownership, no permanent establishment in Colombia, and, where required, a minimum shareholding period. The documentation must be submitted before the payment date and retained in the taxpayer's file for audit by DIAN.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to foreign beneficiaries generally carry a statutory 30% WHT, reduced to 10% or 0% under many Colombian DTAs; interest paid to foreign financial lenders is generally subject to 15% WHT, commonly reduced to between 0% and 10% under an applicable DTA.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File obligations arise where the taxpayer's gross income or gross assets exceed approximately COP 4,250,000,000 (100,000 UVT) and related-party transactions in the fiscal year exceed approximately COP 425,000,000 (10,000 UVT). Master File obligations apply where the multinational group's consolidated revenue exceeds approximately COP 16,500,000,000. Thresholds are updated annually using the UVT.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not apply UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations. However, the General Anti-Abuse Rule in Article 658-1 E.T. and substance-over-form principles allow DIAN to disregard artificial arrangements. The SAS must demonstrate real people, premises, management decisions, and operational functions in Colombia; otherwise, the entity may be treated as a conduit or shell for tax avoidance purposes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately understating Colombian-source fee income, inflating offshore deductions, sending management fees to a shell foreign entity, or failing to file the Form 110 return despite annual revenue exceeding the minimum threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 402 Law 1819/2016, tax evasion carries imprisonment of 4 to 9 years and a fine of 100% to 300% of the evaded tax. Administrative civil penalties can reach 200% of the amount sought to be evaded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, legal representatives, and accountants who sign a false return can be jointly liable for unpaid tax and subject to asset seizures, travel bans, and disqualification from serving as officers of Colombian companies. Corporate veil-piercing is permitted under Article 42 Law 1258/2008.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the transfer pricing declaration, omitting related-party cross-border services or carbon credit transactions, or charging non-arm's-length prices for ESG audit services to offshore affiliates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax adjustment is computed at the arm's-length price, with a penalty of 100% to 300% of the resulting tax underpayment. Separate fines apply for missing documentation, up to 1,000 UVT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve false transfer pricing documentation or who fail to implement the required TP master file can be held personally liable for resulting tax deficiencies and may face criminal liability if fraud is established.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Abuse of Corporate Personality
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an SAS with no office, no substantive employees, no Colombian bank accounts, or no board decisions, while using invoices routed through non-resident shareholders to shift profits from carbon auditing and offset brokerage activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may disregard the SAS as a separate taxpayer, disallow all intra-group deductions, recharacterize the transactions, and impose fines based on the amounts involved. The commercial registry may also be cancelled for deceitful operation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under Law 1258/2008, judges may pierce the veil when the SAS is used for fraud or improper conduct, making shareholders and directors personally, civilly, and fiscally liable for the company's obligations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML Non-Compliance in Carbon Offset Brokerage
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Handling client funds for carbon credit purchases, mitigating brokerage proceeds, or accepting wire transfers without adopting mandatory AML controls, customer due diligence, or suspicious transaction reporting to Colombia's UIAF.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines may reach several thousand UVT depending on the financial volume; registration with the Financial Superintendency or applicable AML authority may be ordered; egregious cases result in administrative liquidation and criminal proceedings under Colombia's criminal code.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face travel bans, personal fines, disqualification, and imprisonment of up to 12 years for laundering money derived from environmental fraud or unlawful offset schemes.
